_description: Tracks bug reports the Bug Watcher has attempted to fix.

8c7b5e7417308f963024177b8b5635fa1a601c3f.notes: Added rw-product-detail class to .rw-product-info in ProductPage.jsx. Fixed ambiguous .rw-product-page → #rw-product-page selector in test. Committed to main and pushed — Railway auto-deploys.

3237eb4a3e6bf60a640555b90af7945e774eb748.notes: Railway RAILPACK build failed for 3 consecutive commits (310b8a7, b0cce37, 387bd69): Rollup could not resolve import "agentation" from src/App.jsx because agentation is in devDependencies and Railway runs npm install with --omit=dev. Moved agentation to dependencies in package.json. Commit ec58848 → main.

89555b2f9c630392bd7e24252e47b2da7af67e82.notes: Removed inline onload='this.onload=null;this.rel=stylesheet' from Google Fonts preload link in index.html; replaced with plain <link rel=stylesheet>. Inline event handler violated helmet CSP script-src-attr 'none'. Verified locally: CSP test passes (1 passed), build ok. Commit 020bb81 -> main, Railway auto-deploys.

cfe923fa07af4b4b54344fc23341176b5f7a3cde.notes: Data-collection script (email-monitor.py, ~/.hermes/scripts/) failed with exit code -15 (SIGTERM). Root cause: Gmail IMAP calls had NO timeouts; a transient Gmail stall hung the process and the cron runner killed it. Hardened script: socket.setdefaulttimeout(15), IMAP4_SSL(timeout=15), signal.alarm(25) deadline that exits cleanly rc=0 instead of hanging. Verified normal run rc=0 valid JSON. Backup kept.
